source_row.english: "Meaningless speech" really refers to every case of words spoken in an afflicted state of mind. Other groups say that what "meaningless speech" actually refers to is every afflicted type of the spoken word other than those three already mentioned. They say cases would be like a monk's engaging in the improper livelihood of flattering someone for the purpose of some gain, or else singing a song out of desire.
